propositions: The close precheck unconditionally invokes the completion verifier even when the ticket already contains a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the same resolved SHA.
A valid stored completion op-cert with authenticated SHA pin, material fingerprint, and PASS status should be reused during close to eliminate redundant provider calls.

A reuse-eligible attestation requires cryptographic verification, matching resolved close ref, current material fingerprint, and valid ticket lifecycle state; all ineligible records must fall through to fresh verification.
The shared close path (_completion_precheck → verify_with_auto_resume) must check for a reusable attested PASS before dispatching to the external provider.
A close at the exact SHA of a valid stored completion PASS must result in zero provider calls while still producing a signed closed ticket with durable completion evidence.
